What do you want to improve first?

This tool creates a plan on your device. It does not contact customers, publish anything or start a paid membership.

Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your business name, location, website, category and accessibility information.
  2. Explain your services, qualifications when relevant, sanitation approach, who the service is for and what customers should expect.
  3. Create one useful preparation topic without making medical, cosmetic-result or fitness-outcome promises.
  4. Track listing interest, bookings and repeat visits separately.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not make unsupported medical, cosmetic-result or fitness claims.
  • Be clear about cancellation, package and recurring-charge terms before any future transaction.
  • Paid membership never changes credentials, safety information or ordinary directory placement.
